common_acceptance_requirements.execution: Future tests only, fresh owned synthetic scratch under existing pinned offline Nix; do not run old reviewer harnesses or mutate their trees. No new dependencies or host manager provisioning in this proposal.
common_acceptance_requirements.fault_reach: Every parameterized row must assert its own exact seam event/count and positive baseline reach. A preflight failure, API missing/import failure, timeout or earlier unrelated fault is not RED evidence for a later cutpoint.
common_acceptance_requirements.origins: For every injected exception assert caught.value is injected_origin and originating frame remains; independent cleanup errors may add sanitized notes only. For no injected exception explicitly assert no origin/no unexpected exception. For killed children assert reached checkpoint and exact termination, not a fabricated exception identity.
common_acceptance_requirements.foreign_trees: Snapshot independent foreign roots (empty0700 and sentinel variants) before each test: inode, owner/mode, entry set and privately compared bytes. Compare after and assert no create/write/chmod/unlink/rename/repair by system under test; adversary's deliberate rename is tracked separately. Do not publish secret hashes.
common_acceptance_requirements.effects: Launch/engine/SQL/seeder/E2E/provider spies must all remain zero, including recovery and error handling.
common_acceptance_requirements.private_output: Capture CLI/stdout/stderr/receipt/notes; synthetic private bytes and derived hashes must be absent. Only public attestations may be printed.
common_acceptance_requirements.verdict: Pass only all declared fault rows with reach, origin and foreign checks; record actual counts in the later implementation report. This artifact declares no executed case count.

acceptance_cases.origin_foreign: Common origin/foreign invariants; legacy RED explicitly records adopted foreign tree changed as the observed violation, replacement must leave foreign empty and original allocation absent/untouched.
